notes.title: 🚀 Unique event: Catch the 🛸 UFO in the game! 🚀
notes.content:
🚀 Unique event: Catch the 🛸 UFO in the game! 🚀

Greetings to all kitty alien lovers! We have amazing news for you! An incredible event is starting in our game, which will give you the opportunity to get rare and unique items!

🕒 Every 18 hours you will be able to get a random item just by logging into the game. Don't miss your chance!

🌌 Possible rewards:


 🎨 0.01% chance to get a Painted UFO - a unique and incredibly rare artifact that will add bright colors and exoticism to your inventory!
 🛸 99.9% chance to get Black and White UFO - no less valuable, but a little more familiar.


Don't miss your opportunity to get a unique item and show off to your friends! Get in the game, participate in the event and test your luck!

💥 Start UFO hunting right now! 💥
